rationale: Dzianis brings hands-on web3 and blockchain engineering from Coinbase, while Kaushik is a founding engineer at EnvoyAI exploring AI-native applications after a decade scaling backend systems at Zillow, Intuit, and Cerner. They complement each other well across distributed systems expertise, backend infrastructure, and emerging technology domains—Dzianis's fintech and developer-tools background pairs naturally with Kaushik's conviction that AI and robotics are reshaping enterprise operations.
intro_message: Dzianis, meet Kaushik Sivakumar—a founding engineer diving into AI and robotics who spent a decade building systems at scale, and you bring blockchain and web3 expertise from Coinbase; could be a good pairing to explore emerging tech infrastructure.
